  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

  # automatic systematics?
  automatic_systematics: True

  number_of_cpus: 10

    # presel_tau: "tau_select_TightRNN_NOSYS"

general:
  debug_level: DEBUG

  # paths
  input_filelist_path: "../input/filelist_v03.txt"
  input_sumweights_path: "../input/sum_of_weights_v03.txt"
  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_sys_test"
  output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_sys_1l_allVR"
  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_nom_1l_allVR"
  output_path_ntuples: "./output_ntuples/taunub/0tauVR/"

  # weights
  default_sumweights: "NOSYS"
  # default_event_weights: "weight_mc_NOSYS * weight_pileup_NOSYS"
  default_event_weights: "weight_mc_NOSYS * weight_pileup_NOSYS * tauSF_NOSYS * elSF_NOSYS * muonSF_NOSYS * jetSF_NOSYS * weight_ftag_effSF_GN2v01_Continuous_NOSYS * globalTriggerEffSFSLT_wpSet0_NOSYS"

  # overwrite_event_weights: True
  default_reco_tree_name: "reco"

  # path to the file with cross-sections
  xsection_files:
    # - files: ["/cvmfs/atlas.cern.ch/repo/sw/database/GroupData/dev/PMGTools/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
    - files: ["/afs/cern.ch/work/z/zang/LQanalysis/taux_fastframes/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
      campaigns: ["mc20a","mc20d","mc20e"]

  # # name of the custom class
  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

  # automatic systematics?
  automatic_systematics: True
  nominal_only: False
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "JET.*", "EG.*", "FT_EFF.*", "PRW.*", "TAUS.*"] # include Theory systematics
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "EG.*", "TAUS.*", "FT_EFF.*"] # Theory, PRW AND JET uncertainties
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "EG.*", "TAUS.*"] # Theory, PRW,JET and FT uncertainties

  # # which objects to create lorentz vectors for
  create_tlorentz_vectors_for: ["jet","mu","el","tau"]

  number_of_cpus: 10

  custom_options:
    # https://gitlab.cern.ch/atlas-phys/exot/lpx/exot-2022-34/taux_fastframes/-/blob/master/TauXFastFrame/TauXFastFrame/WorkingPointMap.h
    wpSet: "wpSet0" # LooseRNN
    # wpSet: "" 
    # wpElectron: "TightLH_Loose_VarRad"
    # wpMuon: "Loose_Loose_VarRad"
    # wpTau: "TightRNN"
    # presel_el: "el_select_TightLH_HighPtCaloOnly_NOSYS && el_pt_NOSYS > 10000" # tight electron id and high pt calo only iso
    presel_el: "el_select_TightLH_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && el_pt_NOSYS > 10000" # tight electron id and high pt calo only iso
    # presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Tight_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    # presel_tau: "tau_select_TightRNN_NOSYS" 
    # presel_tau: "tau_select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_tau: "tau_select_LooseRNN_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_jet: "abs(jet_eta) < 2.5 && jet_pt_NOSYS > 20000"

general:
  debug_level: DEBUG

  # paths
  input_filelist_path: "../input/filelist_v03.txt"
  input_sumweights_path: "../input/sum_of_weights_v03.txt"
  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_sys_test"
  output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_sys_1l_allVR_loose_CRVR" #tch WCR, 0tauVR and 1tauVR: met>400 -> 300 GeV, sch 1tauTopVR: M(tau, b) >400 -> 200 GeV
  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_nom_1l_allVR"
  output_path_ntuples: "./output_ntuples/taunub/0tauVR/"

  # weights
  default_sumweights: "NOSYS"
  # default_event_weights: "weight_mc_NOSYS * weight_pileup_NOSYS"
  default_event_weights: "weight_mc_NOSYS * weight_pileup_NOSYS * tauSF_NOSYS * elSF_NOSYS * muonSF_NOSYS * jetSF_NOSYS * weight_ftag_effSF_GN2v01_Continuous_NOSYS * globalTriggerEffSFSLT_wpSet0_NOSYS"

  # overwrite_event_weights: True
  default_reco_tree_name: "reco"

  # path to the file with cross-sections
  xsection_files:
    # - files: ["/cvmfs/atlas.cern.ch/repo/sw/database/GroupData/dev/PMGTools/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
    - files: ["/afs/cern.ch/work/z/zang/LQanalysis/taux_fastframes/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
      campaigns: ["mc20a","mc20d","mc20e"]

  # # name of the custom class
  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

  # automatic systematics?
  automatic_systematics: True
  nominal_only: False
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "JET.*", "EG.*", "FT_EFF.*", "PRW.*", "TAUS.*"] # include Theory systematics
  #exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "EG.*", "TAUS.*", "FT_EFF.*"] # Theory, PRW AND JET uncertainties
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "EG.*", "TAUS.*"] # Theory, PRW,JET and FT uncertainties

  # # which objects to create lorentz vectors for
  create_tlorentz_vectors_for: ["jet","mu","el","tau"]

  number_of_cpus: 10

  custom_options:
    # https://gitlab.cern.ch/atlas-phys/exot/lpx/exot-2022-34/taux_fastframes/-/blob/master/TauXFastFrame/TauXFastFrame/WorkingPointMap.h
    wpSet: "wpSet0" # LooseRNN
    # wpSet: "" 
    # wpElectron: "TightLH_Loose_VarRad"
    # wpMuon: "Loose_Loose_VarRad"
    # wpTau: "TightRNN"
    # presel_el: "el_select_TightLH_HighPtCaloOnly_NOSYS && el_pt_NOSYS > 10000" # tight electron id and high pt calo only iso
    presel_el: "el_select_TightLH_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && el_pt_NOSYS > 10000" # tight electron id and high pt calo only iso
    # presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Tight_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    # presel_tau: "tau_select_TightRNN_NOSYS" 
    # presel_tau: "tau_select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_tau: "tau_select_LooseRNN_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_jet: "abs(jet_eta) < 2.5 && jet_pt_NOSYS > 20000"
    # presel_el: ""
    # presel_mu: ""
    # presel_tau: "" 
    # presel_jet: ""

# define regions
regions:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1 && Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0 && nbJets85_NOSYS == 1 && flag_minDPhi_NOSYS && MET_wpSet0_met_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800 && Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
    variables: &var_taunub
      - name: "met"
        title : ";E_{T}^{miss} [GeV];Events"
        definition: "MET_wpSet0_met_NOSYS * 0.001"
        type: "double"
        binning:
          bin_edges: [200, 1200]
          # min: 0
          # max: 1500
          # number_of_bins: 15
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_tch"
    selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1 && Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0 && nbJets85_NOSYS == 1 && flag_minDPhi_NOSYS && MET_wpSet0_met_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 400 && Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 600 && abs(Taus_NOSYS[0].DeltaPhi(MET_NOSYS)) > 1.2 && Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 2 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 < 250 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 50"
    variables:

  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

    # wpTau: "TightRNN"

general:
  debug_level: DEBUG

  # paths
  input_filelist_path: "../input/filelist_v03.txt"
  input_sumweights_path: "../input/sum_of_weights_v03.txt"
  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_sys_test"

  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_nom_1l_allVR"
  output_path_ntuples: "./output_ntuples/taunub/0tauVR/"

  # weights
  default_sumweights: "NOSYS"
  # default_event_weights: "weight_mc_NOSYS * weight_pileup_NOSYS"
  default_event_weights: "weight_mc_NOSYS * weight_pileup_NOSYS * tauSF_NOSYS * elSF_NOSYS * muonSF_NOSYS * jetSF_NOSYS * weight_ftag_effSF_GN2v01_Continuous_NOSYS * globalTriggerEffSFSLT_wpSet0_NOSYS"

  # overwrite_event_weights: True
  default_reco_tree_name: "reco"

  # path to the file with cross-sections
  xsection_files:
    # - files: ["/cvmfs/atlas.cern.ch/repo/sw/database/GroupData/dev/PMGTools/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
    - files: ["/afs/cern.ch/work/z/zang/LQanalysis/taux_fastframes/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
      campaigns: ["mc20a","mc20d","mc20e"]

  # # name of the custom class
  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

  # automatic systematics?
  automatic_systematics: True
  nominal_only: False
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "JET.*", "EG.*", "FT_EFF.*", "PRW.*", "TAUS.*"] # include Theory systematics
  #exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "EG.*", "TAUS.*", "FT_EFF.*"] # Theory, PRW AND JET uncertainties
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "EG.*", "TAUS.*"] # Theory, PRW,JET and FT uncertainties

  # # which objects to create lorentz vectors for
  create_tlorentz_vectors_for: ["jet","mu","el","tau"]

  number_of_cpus: 10

  custom_options:
    # https://gitlab.cern.ch/atlas-phys/exot/lpx/exot-2022-34/taux_fastframes/-/blob/master/TauXFastFrame/TauXFastFrame/WorkingPointMap.h
    wpSet: "wpSet0" # LooseRNN
    # wpSet: "" 
    # wpElectron: "TightLH_Loose_VarRad"
    # wpMuon: "Loose_Loose_VarRad"
    # wpTau: "TightRNN"
    # presel_el: "el_select_TightLH_HighPtCaloOnly_NOSYS && el_pt_NOSYS > 10000" # tight electron id and high pt calo only iso
    presel_el: "el_select_TightLH_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && el_pt_NOSYS > 10000" # tight electron id and high pt calo only iso
    # presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Tight_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    # presel_tau: "tau_select_TightRNN_NOSYS" 
    # presel_tau: "tau_select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_tau: "tau_select_LooseRNN_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_jet: "abs(jet_eta) < 2.5 && jet_pt_NOSYS > 20000"

general:
  debug_level: DEBUG

  # paths
  input_filelist_path: "../input/filelist_v03.txt"
  input_sumweights_path: "../input/sum_of_weights_v03.txt"
  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_sys_test"
  output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_sys_1l_allVR_with_beamspot"
  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_nom_1l_allVR"
  output_path_ntuples: "./output_ntuples/taunub/0tauVR/"

  # weights
  default_sumweights: "NOSYS"
  default_event_weights: "weight_mc_NOSYS * weight_pileup_NOSYS * weight_beamspot * weight_beamspot * tauSF_NOSYS * elSF_NOSYS * muonSF_NOSYS * jetSF_NOSYS * weight_ftag_effSF_GN2v01_Continuous_NOSYS * globalTriggerEffSFSLT_wpSet0_NOSYS"

  # overwrite_event_weights: True
  default_reco_tree_name: "reco"

  # path to the file with cross-sections
  xsection_files:
    # - files: ["/cvmfs/atlas.cern.ch/repo/sw/database/GroupData/dev/PMGTools/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
    - files: ["/afs/cern.ch/work/z/zang/LQanalysis/taux_fastframes/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
      campaigns: ["mc20a","mc20d","mc20e"]

  # # name of the custom class
  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

  # automatic systematics?
  automatic_systematics: True
  nominal_only: False
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "JET.*", "EG.*", "FT_EFF.*", "PRW.*", "TAUS.*"] # include Theory systematics
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "EG.*", "TAUS.*", "FT_EFF.*"] # Theory, PRW AND JET uncertainties
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "EG.*", "TAUS.*"] # Theory, PRW,JET and FT uncertainties

  # # which objects to create lorentz vectors for
  create_tlorentz_vectors_for: ["jet","mu","el","tau"]

  number_of_cpus: 10

  custom_options:
    # https://gitlab.cern.ch/atlas-phys/exot/lpx/exot-2022-34/taux_fastframes/-/blob/master/TauXFastFrame/TauXFastFrame/WorkingPointMap.h
    wpSet: "wpSet0" # LooseRNN
    # wpSet: "" 
    # wpElectron: "TightLH_Loose_VarRad"
    # wpMuon: "Loose_Loose_VarRad"
    # wpTau: "TightRNN"
    # presel_el: "el_select_TightLH_HighPtCaloOnly_NOSYS && el_pt_NOSYS > 10000" # tight electron id and high pt calo only iso
    presel_el: "el_select_TightLH_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && el_pt_NOSYS > 10000" # tight electron id and high pt calo only iso
    # presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Tight_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    # presel_tau: "tau_select_TightRNN_NOSYS" 
    # presel_tau: "tau_select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_tau: "tau_select_LooseRNN_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_jet: "abs(jet_eta) < 2.5 && jet_pt_NOSYS > 20000"

general:
  debug_level: DEBUG

  # paths
  input_filelist_path: "../input/filelist_v03.txt"
  input_sumweights_path: "../input/sum_of_weights_v03.txt"
  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_sys_test"
  output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_sys_1l_allVR_with_beamspot"
  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_nom_1l_allVR"
  output_path_ntuples: "./output_ntuples/taunub/0tauVR/"

  # weights
  default_sumweights: "NOSYS"
  # default_event_weights: "weight_mc_NOSYS * weight_pileup_NOSYS * weight_beamspot"
  default_event_weights: "weight_mc_NOSYS * weight_pileup_NOSYS * weight_beamspot * tauSF_NOSYS * elSF_NOSYS * muonSF_NOSYS * jetSF_NOSYS * weight_ftag_effSF_GN2v01_Continuous_NOSYS * globalTriggerEffSFSLT_wpSet0_NOSYS"

  # overwrite_event_weights: True
  default_reco_tree_name: "reco"

  # path to the file with cross-sections
  xsection_files:
    # - files: ["/cvmfs/atlas.cern.ch/repo/sw/database/GroupData/dev/PMGTools/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
    - files: ["/afs/cern.ch/work/z/zang/LQanalysis/taux_fastframes/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
      campaigns: ["mc20a","mc20d","mc20e"]

  # # name of the custom class
  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

  # automatic systematics?
  automatic_systematics: True
  nominal_only: False
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "JET.*", "EG.*", "FT_EFF.*", "PRW.*", "TAUS.*"] # include Theory systematics
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "EG.*", "TAUS.*", "FT_EFF.*"] # Theory, PRW AND JET uncertainties
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "EG.*", "TAUS.*"] # Theory, PRW,JET and FT uncertainties

  # # which objects to create lorentz vectors for
  create_tlorentz_vectors_for: ["jet","mu","el","tau"]

  number_of_cpus: 10

  custom_options:
    # https://gitlab.cern.ch/atlas-phys/exot/lpx/exot-2022-34/taux_fastframes/-/blob/master/TauXFastFrame/TauXFastFrame/WorkingPointMap.h
    wpSet: "wpSet0" # LooseRNN
    # wpSet: "" 
    # wpElectron: "TightLH_Loose_VarRad"
    # wpMuon: "Loose_Loose_VarRad"
    # wpTau: "TightRNN"
    # presel_el: "el_select_TightLH_HighPtCaloOnly_NOSYS && el_pt_NOSYS > 10000" # tight electron id and high pt calo only iso
    presel_el: "el_select_TightLH_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && el_pt_NOSYS > 10000" # tight electron id and high pt calo only iso
    # presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Tight_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    # presel_tau: "tau_select_TightRNN_NOSYS" 
    # presel_tau: "tau_select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_tau: "tau_select_LooseRNN_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_jet: "abs(jet_eta) < 2.5 && jet_pt_NOSYS > 20000"
    # presel_el: ""
    # presel_mu: ""
    # presel_tau: "" 
    # presel_jet: ""

  debug_level: DEBUG

  # paths
  input_filelist_path: "../input/filelist_v03.txt"

  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_sys_test"
  output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_sys_1l_allVR_with_beamspot"

  default_reco_tree_name: "reco"

    - files: ["/afs/cern.ch/work/z/zang/LQanalysis/taux_fastframes/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
      campaigns: ["mc20a","mc20d","mc20e"]

  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

  # # which objects to create lorentz vectors for
  create_tlorentz_vectors_for: ["jet","mu","el","tau"]

  number_of_cpus: 10

    # wpTau: "TightRNN"
    # presel_el: "el_select_TightLH_HighPtCaloOnly_NOSYS && el_pt_NOSYS > 10000" # tight electron id and high pt calo only iso

    # presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Tight_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    # presel_tau: "tau_select_TightRNN_NOSYS" 
    # presel_tau: "tau_select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_tau: "tau_select_LooseRNN_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_jet: "abs(jet_eta) < 2.5 && jet_pt_NOSYS > 20000"

  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_nom_1l_allVR"

  default_sumweights: "NOSYS"

    - files: ["/afs/cern.ch/work/z/zang/LQanalysis/taux_fastframes/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]

  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

general:
  debug_level: DEBUG

  # paths
  input_filelist_path: "../input/filelist_v03.txt"
  input_sumweights_path: "../input/sum_of_weights_v03.txt"
  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_sys_test"
  output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_sys_1l_allVR_with_beamspot"
  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_nom_1l_allVR"
  output_path_ntuples: "./output_ntuples/taunub/0tauVR/"

  # weights
  default_sumweights: "NOSYS"
  # default_event_weights: "weight_mc_NOSYS * weight_pileup_NOSYS * weight_beamspot"

  default_reco_tree_name: "reco"

  # path to the file with cross-sections
  xsection_files:
    # - files: ["/cvmfs/atlas.cern.ch/repo/sw/database/GroupData/dev/PMGTools/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
    - files: ["/afs/cern.ch/work/z/zang/LQanalysis/taux_fastframes/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
      campaigns: ["mc20a","mc20d","mc20e"]

  # # name of the custom class
  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

  # automatic systematics?
  automatic_systematics: True
  nominal_only: False
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "JET.*", "EG.*", "FT_EFF.*", "PRW.*", "TAUS.*"] # include Theory systematics

  # # which objects to create lorentz vectors for
  create_tlorentz_vectors_for: ["jet","mu","el","tau"]

  number_of_cpus: 10

  custom_options:
    # https://gitlab.cern.ch/atlas-phys/exot/lpx/exot-2022-34/taux_fastframes/-/blob/master/TauXFastFrame/TauXFastFrame/WorkingPointMap.h
    wpSet: "wpSet0" # LooseRNN

    # wpElectron: "TightLH_Loose_VarRad"
    # wpMuon: "Loose_Loose_VarRad"
    # wpTau: "TightRNN"
    # presel_el: "el_select_TightLH_HighPtCaloOnly_NOSYS && el_pt_NOSYS > 10000" # tight electron id and high pt calo only iso

    # presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Tight_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    # presel_tau: "tau_select_TightRNN_NOSYS" 
    # presel_tau: "tau_select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_tau: "tau_select_LooseRNN_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_jet: "abs(jet_eta) < 2.5 && jet_pt_NOSYS > 20000"

  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

# define cutflows
cutflows:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    # samples: ["LQ_taunub_M1500"] # optional, default is all samples
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200"
        title: "mT_200"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4"
        title: "max_nJets_4"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800"
        title: "Mbtau_800"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
        title: "bjet_pt_250"

  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_tch"
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 400"
        title: "met_400"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 600"
        title: "mT_600"
      - selection: "abs(Taus_NOSYS[0].DeltaPhi(MET_NOSYS)) > 1.2"
        title: "tau_met_deltaphi_1p2"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 2"
        title: "max_nJets_2"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 < 250 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 50"
        title: "bjet_pt_50_250"

# define cutflows
cutflows:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    # samples: ["LQ_taunub_M1500"] # optional, default is all samples
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200"
        title: "mT_200"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4"
        title: "max_nJets_4"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800"
        title: "Mbtau_800"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
        title: "bjet_pt_250"

  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_tch"
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 400"
        title: "met_400"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 600"
        title: "mT_600"
      - selection: "abs(Taus_NOSYS[0].DeltaPhi(MET_NOSYS)) > 1.2"
        title: "tau_met_deltaphi_1p2"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 2"
        title: "max_nJets_2"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 < 250 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 50"
        title: "bjet_pt_50_250"

# define regions
regions:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS() == 1 && Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0 && nbJets85_NOSYS == 1 && flag_minDPhi_NOSYS && MET_wpSet0_met_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800 && Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
    variables: &var_taunub
      - name: "met"
        title : ";E_{T}^{miss} [GeV];Events"
        definition: "MET_wpSet0_met_NOSYS * 0.001"
        type: "double"
        binning:
          bin_edges: [200, 2000]
          # min: 0
          # max: 1500
          # number_of_bins: 15
      # - name: "mT"
      #   title : ";m_{T}{tau,met};Events"
      #   definition: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001"
      #   type: "double"

      #     min: 200
      #     max: 1500

# define cutflows
cutflows:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    # samples: ["LQ_taunub_M1500"] # optional, default is all samples
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200"
        title: "mT_200"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4"
        title: "max_nJets_4"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800"
        title: "Mbtau_800"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
        title: "bjet_pt_250"

  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_tch"
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 400"
        title: "met_400"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 600"
        title: "mT_600"
      - selection: "abs(Taus_NOSYS[0].DeltaPhi(MET_NOSYS)) > 1.2"
        title: "tau_met_deltaphi_1p2"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 2"
        title: "max_nJets_2"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 < 250 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 50"
        title: "bjet_pt_50_250"

# define regions
regions:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS() == 1 && Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0 && nbJets85_NOSYS == 1 && flag_minDPhi_NOSYS && MET_wpSet0_met_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800 && Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
    variables: &var_taunub
      - name: "met"
        title : ";E_{T}^{miss} [GeV];Events"
        definition: "MET_wpSet0_met_NOSYS * 0.001"

  default_reco_tree_name: "reco"

  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

# define cutflows
cutflows:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    # samples: ["LQ_taunub_M1500"] # optional, default is all samples
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200"
        title: "mT_200"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4"
        title: "max_nJets_4"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800"
        title: "Mbtau_800"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
        title: "bjet_pt_250"

  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_tch"
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 400"
        title: "met_400"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 600"
        title: "mT_600"
      - selection: "abs(Taus_NOSYS[0].DeltaPhi(MET_NOSYS)) > 1.2"
        title: "tau_met_deltaphi_1p2"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 2"
        title: "max_nJets_2"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 < 250 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 50"
        title: "bjet_pt_50_250"

# define regions

# define cutflows
cutflows:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    # samples: ["LQ_taunub_M1500"] # optional, default is all samples
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200"
        title: "mT_200"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4"
        title: "max_nJets_4"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800"
        title: "Mbtau_800"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
        title: "bjet_pt_250"

  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_tch"
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"

  # overwrite_event_weights: True
  default_reco_tree_name: "reco"

  # path to the file with cross-sections
  xsection_files:
    # - files: ["/cvmfs/atlas.cern.ch/repo/sw/database/GroupData/dev/PMGTools/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
    - files: ["/afs/cern.ch/work/z/zang/LQanalysis/taux_fastframes/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]

  # # name of the custom class
  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

  automatic_systematics: True
  nominal_only: False
  # automatic_systematics: False
  # nominal_only: True
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "JET.*", "EG.*", "FT_EFF.*", "PRW.*", "TAUS.*"] # include Theory systematics

  # # which objects to create lorentz vectors for
  create_tlorentz_vectors_for: ["jet","mu","el","tau"]

  number_of_cpus: 4

  custom_options:
    # https://gitlab.cern.ch/atlas-phys/exot/lpx/exot-2022-34/taux_fastframes/-/blob/master/TauXFastFrame/TauXFastFrame/WorkingPointMap.h
    wpSet: "wpSet0" # LooseRNN

    # wpMuon: "Loose_Loose_VarRad"
    # wpTau: "TightRNN"

    presel_el: "el_select_TightLH_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && el_pt_NOSYS > 10000" # tight electron id and high pt calo only iso
    presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    # presel_mu: "mu_select_Medium_Tight_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"
    presel_tau: "tau_select_LooseRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_jet: "abs(jet_eta) < 2.5 && jet_pt_NOSYS > 20000"

    # presel_mu: ""
    # presel_tau: "" 
    # presel_jet: ""

cutflows:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"

    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS() == 1"

      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"

      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200"

      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4"

      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800"

# define cutflows
cutflows:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    # samples: ["LQ_taunub_M1500"] # optional, default is all samples
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200"
        title: "mT_200"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4"
        title: "max_nJets_4"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800"
        title: "Mbtau_800"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
        title: "bjet_pt_250"

  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_tch"
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 400"
        title: "met_400"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 600"
        title: "mT_600"
      - selection: "abs(Taus_NOSYS[0].DeltaPhi(MET_NOSYS)) > 1.2"
        title: "tau_met_deltaphi_1p2"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 2"
        title: "max_nJets_2"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 < 250 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 50"
        title: "bjet_pt_50_250"

# define regions
regions:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1 && Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0 && nbJets85_NOSYS == 1 && flag_minDPhi_NOSYS && MET_wpSet0_met_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800 && Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"

# define cutflows
cutflows:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    # samples: ["LQ_taunub_M1500"] # optional, default is all samples
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200"
        title: "mT_200"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4"
        title: "max_nJets_4"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800"
        title: "Mbtau_800"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
        title: "bjet_pt_250"

  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_tch"
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 400"
        title: "met_400"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 600"
        title: "mT_600"
      - selection: "abs(Taus_NOSYS[0].DeltaPhi(MET_NOSYS)) > 1.2"
        title: "tau_met_deltaphi_1p2"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 2"

      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"

      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 < 250 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 50"

    selections:

        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"

      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"

      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200"

      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"

cutflows:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    # samples: ["LQ_taunub_M1500"] # optional, default is all samples
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200"
        title: "mT_200"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4"
        title: "max_nJets_4"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800"
        title: "Mbtau_800"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
        title: "bjet_pt_250"

  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_tch"
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs

      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"

# define cutflows
cutflows:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    # samples: ["LQ_taunub_M1500"] # optional, default is all samples
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200"
        title: "mT_200"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4"
        title: "max_nJets_4"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800"
        title: "Mbtau_800"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
        title: "bjet_pt_250"

  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_tch"
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 400"
        title: "met_400"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 600"
        title: "mT_600"
      - selection: "abs(Taus_NOSYS[0].DeltaPhi(MET_NOSYS)) > 1.2"
        title: "tau_met_deltaphi_1p2"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 2"
        title: "max_nJets_2"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 < 250 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 50"
        title: "bjet_pt_50_250"

# define regions
regions:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1 && Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0 && nbJets85_NOSYS == 1 && flag_minDPhi_NOSYS && MET_wpSet0_met_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800 && Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
    variables: &var_taunub
      - name: "met"
        title : ";E_{T}^{miss} [GeV];Events"
        definition: "MET_wpSet0_met_NOSYS * 0.001"
        type: "double"
        binning:
          bin_edges: [0, 2000]
          # min: 0
          # max: 1500
          # number_of_bins: 15

  # overwrite_event_weights: True
  default_reco_tree_name: "reco"

  # path to the file with cross-sections
  xsection_files:
    # - files: ["/cvmfs/atlas.cern.ch/repo/sw/database/GroupData/dev/PMGTools/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
    - files: ["/afs/cern.ch/work/z/zang/LQanalysis/taux_fastframes/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]

  # # name of the custom class
  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

  # automatic systematics?
  automatic_systematics: True
  nominal_only: False
  # automatic_systematics: False
  # nominal_only: True
  # exclude_systematics: ["EL.*", "MUON.*", "MET.*", "JET.*", "EG.*", "FT_EFF.*", "PRW.*", "TAUS.*"] # include Theory systematics

  create_tlorentz_vectors_for: ["jet","mu","el","tau"]

    wpSet: "wpSet0" # LooseRNN

    # wpMuon: "Loose_Loose_VarRad"
    # wpTau: "TightRNN"

    presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"

    presel_tau: "tau_select_LooseRNN_noElVeto_NOSYS && tau_pt_NOSYS > 20000" 
    presel_jet: "abs(jet_eta) < 2.5 && jet_pt_NOSYS > 20000"

    # presel_mu: ""
    # presel_tau: "" 
    # presel_jet: ""

# define cutflows
cutflows:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    # samples: ["LQ_taunub_M1500"] # optional, default is all samples
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200"
        title: "mT_200"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4"
        title: "max_nJets_4"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800"
        title: "Mbtau_800"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
        title: "bjet_pt_250"

  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_tch"
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 400"
        title: "met_400"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 600"
        title: "mT_600"
      - selection: "abs(Taus_NOSYS[0].DeltaPhi(MET_NOSYS)) > 1.2"
        title: "tau_met_deltaphi_1p2"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 2"
        title: "max_nJets_2"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 < 250 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 50"
        title: "bjet_pt_50_250"

# define regions

  # overwrite_event_weights: True
  default_reco_tree_name: "reco"

  # path to the file with cross-sections
  xsection_files:

    - files: ["/afs/cern.ch/work/z/zang/LQanalysis/taux_fastframes/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]

  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

  nominal_only: False

# define cutflows
cutflows:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    # samples: ["LQ_taunub_M1500"] # optional, default is all samples
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200"
        title: "mT_200"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4"
        title: "max_nJets_4"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800"
        title: "Mbtau_800"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
        title: "bjet_pt_250"

  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_tch"
    # samples: ["ttbar", "SingleTop", "Ztautau", "Wtaunu_METTAU", "Diboson"] # main BGs
    selections:
      - selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 200"
        title: "met trigger"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1"
        title: "single tau"
      - selection: "Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0"
        title: "lepton veto"
      - selection: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        title: "QCD cleaning"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200"
        title: "tau_pt_200"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].truth_IsHadronicTau()"
        title: "hadronic tau"
      - selection: "MET_NOSYS.met()*0.001 > 400"
        title: "met_400"
      - selection: "Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 600"
        title: "mT_600"
      - selection: "abs(Taus_NOSYS[0].DeltaPhi(MET_NOSYS)) > 1.2"
        title: "tau_met_deltaphi_1p2"
      - selection: "Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 2"
        title: "max_nJets_2"
      - selection: "nbJets85_NOSYS == 1"
        title: "single b jet"
      - selection: "bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 < 250 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 50"
        title: "bjet_pt_50_250"

# define regions
regions:
  - name: "SR_1tau0l1b_sch"
    selection: "flag_MET_decision_NOSYS && Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1 && Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 0 && nbJets85_NOSYS == 1 && flag_minDPhi_NOSYS && MET_wpSet0_met_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 > 200 && Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 > 800 && Jets_NOSYS.size() <= 4 && bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 > 250"
    variables: &var_taunub

  debug_level: DEBUG

  # paths
  input_filelist_path: "../input/filelist_v03.txt"
  input_sumweights_path: "../input/sum_of_weights_v03.txt"
  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_sys_test"
  output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_sys_1l_allVR_SYSdebug"
  # output_path_histograms: "./output_plots/taunub_nom_1l_allVR"

  default_event_weights: "weight_mc_NOSYS * weight_pileup_NOSYS * tauSF_NOSYS * elSF_NOSYS * muonSF_NOSYS * jetSF_NOSYS * weight_ftag_effSF_GN2v01_Continuous_NOSYS * globalTriggerEffSFSLT_wpSet0_NOSYS"

  default_reco_tree_name: "reco"

  xsection_files:
    # - files: ["/cvmfs/atlas.cern.ch/repo/sw/database/GroupData/dev/PMGTools/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]
    - files: ["/afs/cern.ch/work/z/zang/LQanalysis/taux_fastframes/PMGxsecDB_mc16.txt"]

  # # name of the custom class
  custom_frame_name: "TauXFastFrame"

  create_tlorentz_vectors_for: ["jet","mu","el","tau"]

    presel_mu: "mu_select_Loose_Loose_VarRad_NOSYS && mu_pt_NOSYS > 10000"

  input_filelist_path: "../input/filelist_v03.txt"

# define regions for plots
regions:
  - name: "topCR_1tau1l_tch"
    selection: "flag_SLT_decision_NOSYS && Taus_NOSYS.size() == 1 && Taus_NOSYS[0].select_TightRNN_NOSYS() == 1 && Leptons_NOSYS.size() == 1 && nbJets85_NOSYS >= 1"
    variables: &taunublepvariables
      - name: "tau_pt_0"
        title : ";Leading tau p_{T} [GeV];Events"
        definition: "Taus_NOSYS.size() > 0 ? Taus_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 0.001 : 0"
        type: "double"
        binning:
          min: 0
          max: 400
          number_of_bins: 20
      - name: "tauSF"
        title : ";tau Scale Factor;Events"
        definition: "tauSF_NOSYS"
        type: "float"
        binning:
          min: 0
          max: 2
          number_of_bins: 50
      - name: "muonSF"
        title : ";muon Scale Factor;Events"
        definition: "muonSF_NOSYS"
        type: "float"
        binning:
          min: 0.9
          max: 1.1
          number_of_bins: 50
      - name: "elSF"
        title : ";electron Scale Factor;Events"
        definition: "elSF_NOSYS"
        type: "float"
        binning:
          min: 0.9
          max: 1.1
          number_of_bins: 50
      - name: "jetSF"
        title : ";jetSF;Events"
        definition: "jetSF_NOSYS"
        type: "float" 
        binning:
          min: 0.95
          max: 1.05
          number_of_bins: 50
      - name: "TriggerSF"
        title : ";SLT EffSF;Events"
        definition: "globalTriggerEffSFSLT_wpSet0_NOSYS"
        type: "float"
        binning:
          min: 0.9
          max: 1.1
          number_of_bins: 50
      # - name: "NNLO_reweight"
      #   title : ";weight_NNLO_3D_NOSYS;Events"
      #   definition: "weight_NNLO_3D_NOSYS"
      #   type: "double"
      #   binning:
      #     min: 0.5
      #     max: 1.5
      #     number_of_bins: 50
      - name: "bJets85_pt_0"
        title : ";bJets85_0 p_{T} [GeV];Events"
        definition: "nbJets85_NOSYS > 0 ? bJets85_pt_0_NOSYS * 1e-3 : 0"
        type: "double"
        binning:
          min: 0
          max: 1000
          number_of_bins: 40
      - name: "weight_ftag_effSF_GN2v01_Continuous"
        title : ";ftag_effSF_GN2v01_Continuous_NOSYS;Events"
        definition: "weight_ftag_effSF_GN2v01_Continuous_NOSYS"
        type: "float"
        binning:
          min: 0.5
          max: 1.5
          number_of_bins: 50
      - name: "Mtaub"
        title : ";M_{taub} [GeV];Events"
        definition: "Taus_NOSYS.size() > 0 ? Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(bJets85_NOSYS[0]) * 0.001 : 0"
        type: "double"
        binning:
          min: 0
          max: 1000
          number_of_bins: 50
      - name: "Mtaumet"
        title : ";M_{taumet} [GeV];Events"
        definition: "Taus_NOSYS.size() > 0 ? Taus_NOSYS[0].InvM(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 : 0"
        type: "double"
        binning:
          min: 0
          max: 1000
          number_of_bins: 50
      - name: "mT_tau_met"
        title : ";m_{T}(tau, met);Events"
        definition: "Taus_NOSYS.size() > 0 ? Taus_NOSYS[0].mT(MET_NOSYS) * 0.001 : 0"
        type: "double"
        binning:
          min: 0
          max: 1000
          number_of_bins: 50
      - name: "tau_met_deltaphi"
        title : ";#Delta#phi(tau, met);Events"
        definition: "Taus_NOSYS.size() > 0 ? abs(Taus_NOSYS[0].DeltaPhi(MET_NOSYS)) : 0"
        type: "double"
        binning:
          min: 0
          max: 3.2
          number_of_bins: 50
      - name: "flag_minDPhi"
        title : ";flag_minDPhi;Events"
        definition: "flag_minDPhi_NOSYS"
        type: "bool"
        binning:
          min: 0
          max: 2
          number_of_bins: 2
          number_of_bins: 8
      - name: "jet_pt_0"
        title : ";p_{T}^{jet0} [GeV];Events"
        definition: "Jets_NOSYS.size()>0 ? Jets_NOSYS[0].Pt() * 1e-3 : 0"
        type: "double"
        binning:
          min: 0
          max: 1500
          number_of_bins: 15
      - name: "TriggerMatch_flag"
        title : ";TriggerMatch flag;Events"
        definition: "globalTriggerMatchSLT_wpSet0_NOSYS == 1 ? 1 : 0"
        type: "int"
        binning:
          min: 0
          max: 2
          number_of_bins: 2
      - name: "truth_met"
        title : ";truth met;Events"
        definition: "PL_MET_met * 1e-3"
        type: "double"
        binning:
          min: 0

class JvtExtraFlagConfig (ConfigBlock) :
    """Block that only computes JVT score for jets adding a new decoration"""

    def __init__ (self, containerName='') :
        super (JvtExtraFlagConfig, self).__init__ ()
        self.setBlockName('JVTExtra')
        self.addOption ('containerName', containerName, type=str,
            noneAction='error',
            info="the name of the input container.")
        self.addOption ('selectionName', '', type=str, info="")
        self.addOption ('runJvtSelection', False, type=bool,
            info="whether to run JVT selection. The default is False.")
        self.addOption ('runFJvtSelection', False, type=bool,
            info="whether to run forward JVT selection. The default is False.")
        self.addOption ('jvtWP', "FixedEffPt", type=str,
            info="which Jvt WP to apply. The default is FixedEffPt.")
        self.addOption ('fJvtWP', "Loose", type=str,
            info="which fJvt WP to apply. The default is Loose.")
        self.addOption ('runJvtEfficiency', True, type=bool,
            info="whether to calculate the JVT efficiency. The default is False.")
        self.addOption ('runFJvtEfficiency', True, type=bool,
            info="whether to calculate the forward JVT efficiency. The default is False.")


    def makeAlgs (self, config) :


        jetCollectionName="AntiKt4EMPFlowJets"


        if self.jvtWP not in ["FixedEffPt"]:
            raise ValueError(
                "Unsupported NNJvt WP '{0}'".format(self.jvtWP) )

        if self.fJvtWP not in ["Loose", "Tight", "Tighter"]:
            raise ValueError(
                "Unsupported fJvt WP '{0}'".format(self.fJvtWP) )

        # Set up the jet efficiency scale factor calculation algorithm
        # Change the truthJetCollection property to AntiKt4TruthWZJets if preferred
        if self.runJvtSelection :
            alg = config.createAlgorithm('CP::AsgSelectionAlg', f'JvtSelectionAlg{self.containerName+self.selectionName}')
            config.addPrivateTool('selectionTool', 'CP::NNJvtSelectionTool')
            alg.selectionTool.JetContainer = config.readName(self.containerName)
            alg.selectionTool.WorkingPoint = self.jvtWP
            alg.selectionTool.MaxPtForJvt = 60*GeV
            alg.selectionDecoration = f"jvt_{self.selectionName},as_char"
            alg.particles = config.readName(self.containerName)

            if self.runJvtEfficiency and config.dataType() is not DataType.Data:
                alg = config.createAlgorithm( 'CP::JvtEfficiencyAlg', 'JvtEfficiencyAlg'+self.containerName+self.selectionName )
                config.addPrivateTool( 'efficiencyTool', 'CP::NNJvtEfficiencyTool' )
                alg.efficiencyTool.JetContainer = config.readName(self.containerName)
                alg.efficiencyTool.MaxPtForJvt = 60*GeV
                alg.efficiencyTool.WorkingPoint = self.jvtWP
                if config.geometry() is LHCPeriod.Run2:
                    alg.efficiencyTool.SFFile = "JetJvtEfficiency/May2024/NNJvtSFFile_Run2_EMPFlow.root"
                else:
                    alg.efficiencyTool.SFFile = "JetJvtEfficiency/May2024/NNJvtSFFile_Run3_EMPFlow.root"
                alg.selection = f"jvt_{self.selectionName},as_char"
                alg.scaleFactorDecoration = f'jvt_{self.selectionName}_effSF_%SYS%'
                alg.outOfValidity = 2
                alg.outOfValidityDeco = 'no_jvt'
                alg.skipBadEfficiency = False
                alg.jets = config.readName (self.containerName)
                alg.preselection = config.getPreselection (self.containerName, '')
                config.addOutputVar (self.containerName, alg.scaleFactorDecoration, 'jvtEfficiency'+self.selectionName)
            config.addSelection (self.containerName, self.selectionName+'Jvt', f"jvt_{self.selectionName},as_char", preselection=False)

        if self.runFJvtSelection :
            alg = config.createAlgorithm('CP::AsgSelectionAlg', f'FJvtSelectionAlg{self.containerName+self.selectionName}')
            config.addPrivateTool('selectionTool', 'CP::FJvtSelectionTool')
            alg.selectionTool.JetContainer = config.readName(self.containerName)
            alg.selectionTool.WorkingPoint = self.fJvtWP
            alg.selectionDecoration = f"fjvt_{self.selectionName},as_char"
            alg.particles = config.readName(self.containerName)

            if self.runFJvtEfficiency and config.dataType() is not DataType.Data:
                alg = config.createAlgorithm( 'CP::JvtEfficiencyAlg', 'FJvtEfficiencyAlg'+self.containerName+self.selectionName )
                config.addPrivateTool( 'efficiencyTool', 'CP::FJvtEfficiencyTool' )
                alg.efficiencyTool.JetContainer = config.readName(self.containerName)
                alg.efficiencyTool.WorkingPoint = self.fJvtWP
                if config.geometry() is LHCPeriod.Run2:
                    alg.efficiencyTool.SFFile = "JetJvtEfficiency/May2024/fJvtSFFile_Run2_EMPFlow.root"
                else:
                    alg.efficiencyTool.SFFile = "JetJvtEfficiency/May2024/fJvtSFFile_Run3_EMPFlow.root"
                alg.selection = f"fjvt_{self.selectionName},as_char"
                alg.scaleFactorDecoration = f'fjvt_{self.selectionName}_effSF_%SYS%'
                alg.outOfValidity = 2
                alg.outOfValidityDeco = 'no_fjvt'
                alg.skipBadEfficiency = False
                alg.jets = config.readName (self.containerName)
                alg.preselection = config.getPreselection (self.containerName, '')
                config.addOutputVar (self.containerName, alg.scaleFactorDecoration, 'fjvtEfficiency'+self.selectionName)
            config.addSelection (self.containerName, self.selectionName+'FJvt', f"fjvt_{self.selectionName},as_char", preselection=False)
